definitions.explanation: Describes something that is noticeably great in degree or extent. Used for changes, progress, differences, or effects that stand out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{著|いちじる}しい。
⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{著|いちじる}しい。
examples.english: The progress of technology is striking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{著|いちじる}しく、⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, the decline in my physical strength has been significant — I run out of breath just climbing stairs.

notes:
{著|いちじる}しい is somewhat formal and often used in written contexts or news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著|いちじる}しい⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧: remarkable growth
- {著|いちじる}しい⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧: striking progress
- {著|いちじる}しい⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧: significant change
- {著|いちじる}しい⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧: marked decline
- {著|いちじる}しく⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to increase remarkably

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {著|いちじる}しい: remarkable, significant (formal, emphasizes degree)
- ⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: conspicuous, noticeable (neutral, visual emphasis)
- ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧: amazing (casual, general intensifier)

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {著|いちじる}しくなかったら
